---
title: CELLxGENE
description: The CELLxGENE Discover dataset catalog as a resource table, with H5AD and Census pointers and ontology-tagged tissues, cell types, assays and diseases.
---

[CELLxGENE Discover](https://cellxgene.cziscience.com) publishes a listing of
every public single-cell dataset. The release lands that listing whole and
derives `resource.cellxgene__dataset`: one row per dataset version with the
organism resolved to a taxon id, the multi-valued fields exploded to sorted
lists of ontology term ids, an `h5ad_uri` and the Census release the cells
join through. Expression matrices are never copied; the row points at public
S3.

The listing has no version of its own, so the version is the retrieval date
and raw holds the latest crawl only.

## Licence and citation

CC BY 4.0, CELLxGENE Discover's uniform licence for public data. Cite
CELLxGENE Discover and the collection's publication, whose DOI the row carries
(`collection_doi`).

## Join keys

- `resource.cellxgene__dataset.dataset_version_id` is the key, and the `resource_id` in `resource.resource_relationship`, where tissues, cell types, assays and diseases are rows (`has_tissue`, `has_cell_type`, …) whose `target_id` joins `ontology.term.term_id`.
- The same ids are also on the dataset row as sorted lists, for `list_contains()` filters.
- `taxon_id` joins every gene table; `census_release` names the Census SOMA build.

## Good to know

- A dataset that disappears from the next crawl, or is superseded by a revision under a new version id, is retired from the table.
- The Census `var` dataframe (`annotation.cellxgene__gene`) is not landed: it is only published inside the TileDB-SOMA store.
